description: This source file defines the class MathIllegalStateException, a custom exception class extending IllegalStateException, used within the Apache Commons Math library for signaling illegal states in mathematical computations. It incorporates localization support and maintains an exception context.

classes.name: MathIllegalStateException
classes.description: Custom exception extending IllegalStateException, indicating the process is in an illegal or invalid state for mathematical computations, with support for localized messages and an exception context.
